clues.text: After his dream, Jacob set up the stone he had slept on as a pillar here and poured oil on it.
King Jeroboam set up one of his two golden calves in this city and put the other in Dan.
Boys from this city mocked a prophet as a baldhead, and two bears came out and mauled forty-two of them.
Amaziah, a priest of this place, told Amos to flee to Judah and never prophesy here again.
Abram pitched his tent with this town to the west and Ai to the east, and built an altar there.
King Josiah tore down Jeroboam's altar in this city and burned bones from nearby tombs on it.
During the war against Benjamin, Israel wept and fasted before the LORD here, where the ark of the covenant then was.
